sentences.text:
Venugopal Nune vs The State Of Andhra Pradesh on 7
December, 2020
 The Hon'Ble Smt Justice Lalitha Kanneganti
 Criminal Petition No.5628 Of 2020
Order:

entities.text: Venugopal Nune vs The State Of Andhra Pradesh
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
-
This Criminal Petition is filed under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 seeking a direction to the Station House Officer, Nagarjunasagar Police Station, Guntur District to release the tobacco product stocks and transport goods vehicle bearing No.AP 27 TT 4114 which are seized in F.I.R.No.97 of 2020 dated 26.05.2020.

2. Heard Sri D.Kasi Rao, learned counsel for the petitioners and learned Public Prosecutor appearing on behalf of the respondent- state.
3.

Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that pursuant to the registration of F.I.R.No.97 of 2020 for the offences punishable under Sections 188, 273, 420 and 328 read with 34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 and Sections 57(1), 58 and 63 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006, the petitioners have approached this Court by way of filing Criminal Petition No.5196 of 2020 seeking to quash proceedings in F.I.R.No.97 of 2020.
4.

This Court has allowed the said quash petition observing that the issue involved in the said petition is squarely covered by the order dated 27.08.2018 passed by this Court in Criminal Petition No.3731 of 2018 and batch.
Subsequently, the petitioners had approached the concerned Police for return of the seized property, but they did not respond properly.
Hence, the petitioners are before this Court.

5. In view of the fact that the above FIR has already been quashed by order dated 17.11.2020 in Criminal Petition No.5196 of 2020, the property that was seized from the petitioners in connection with the subject crime is liable to be returned to them.

6. In view of the above, this Criminal Petition is allowed and the Station House Officer,
Nagarjunasagar Police Station, Guntur District is directed to release the tobacco products and transport goods vehicle bearing No.AP 27 TT 4114 seized in connection with F.I.R.No.97 of 2020.
As a sequel, pending miscellaneous petitions, if any, shall stand closed.

JUSTICE LALITHA KANNEGANTI Date:
07.12.2020 IKN THE HON'BLE SMT JUSTICE LALITHA KANNEGANTI CRIMINAL PETITION No.5628 of 2020 Date: 07.12.2020 IKN Venugopal Nune vs The State Of Andhra Pradesh on 7 December, 2020 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/116274641/
